title: Digital Marketing
overview: Digital marketing refers to promoting products or brands through various electronic channels. Unlike traditional marketing, digital marketing enables organizations to track and analyze campaign performance in real time, providing insights into what works and what doesn’t (SAS). This course offers participants a comprehensive understanding of the modern digital marketing landscape. They will learn new strategies, tools, and techniques to effectively create, distribute, promote, and price products and services in the digital realm.
audience: This course is ideal for marketing and communication professionals looking to deepen their knowledge of digital marketing and social media. It is also highly beneficial for experienced managers responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies within their organizations.
methodology: The course is designed to be action-oriented, focusing on practical outcomes. It involves short presentations by both the consultant and participants, followed by the development of a personalized digital marketing plan using workbooks and provided laptops.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Assess the role of digital platforms in building a solid marketing strategy and determine how to apply each platform to their business.
Identify opportunities for using SEO to add value to their business and benefit customers.
Set up and manage Google AdWords campaigns to boost customer engagement and increase market share through social media.
Leverage Google Analytics to evaluate marketing channels and optimize their use.
Execute a complete digital marketing campaign to improve customer interaction, generate leads, and enhance brand visibility.
